name: Form MultiPopup Quiz Builder
author: Sergey

sections.description:
Form MultiPopup Quiz Builder is a versatile WordPress plugin that combines powerful registration forms with interactive quiz and calculator functionality in customizable popups.

New in Version 1.6:
– 📊 Advanced User Management System with pagination and search
– 📋 Complete user list with export to CSV functionality
– 🔍 Smart search across all user fields (login, email, name, surname)
– 📈 User statistics and role-based filtering
– ⭐ Supporter edition with enhanced export capabilities
– 🛡️ Improved security and WordPress standards compliance

Key Features:

  • Multi-Popup System: Create and manage multiple popup variations with different designs and triggers
  • Quiz Builder: Build engaging quizzes with conditional logic and scoring (coming in v2.0)
  • Form Calculator: Add calculation fields to your forms (price estimators, etc.)
  • Registration Forms: Full-featured user registration system with spam protection
  • User Management: Complete admin interface for managing registered users
  • Responsive Design: Works perfectly on all devices
  • Customizable Triggers: Control popups by scroll, exit intent, or timers

Perfect for:
✓ Lead generation and user registration
✓ Interactive quizzes and assessments
✓ Calculation forms and price estimators
✓ User management and analytics
✓ Membership sites and communities

External Services

This plugin uses the following third-party services:

reCAPTCHA Service (optional)

When enabled in settings, the plugin uses reCAPTCHA v3 to protect forms from spam submissions.

What data is sent:
– User’s IP address (implicitly collected by reCAPTCHA)
– reCAPTCHA site key (configured in plugin settings)
– User interactions with the form (for spam analysis)

When data is sent:
– When a form with reCAPTCHA protection is loaded
– When a protected form is submitted

Service provider:
– reCAPTCHA Terms of Service
– reCAPTCHA Privacy Policy

Note: reCAPTCHA is optional and only activated if you configure a site key in the plugin settings.

SMS.ru Service (under development)

Function of sending SMS via the service SMS.ru is temporarily disabled and under development.

You plan to use this service to send notifications to users. When activated, the following data will be transmitted:
– Recipient’s phone number
– Message text
– API key for authorization

The service is provided by the company SMS.ru:
– Terms of Use
– Privacy Policy

At the moment, no data is being transmitted. You can support the project by leaving a review or rating.

Support

For support and feature requests, please visit:
– Plugin Support Forum
– Official Website

Support the development by leaving a review or making a donation!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the WordPress plugins menu
  3. Configure settings under Settings → Form MultiPopup Quiz Builder
  4. Use shortcodes:
    • [fmpqb_registration_form] for registration forms
    • [mpqb_quiz] for quizzes (available in v2.0)
  5. Access user management under Form Registration → Users
sections.faq:
How do I use the registration form?

Use the shortcode [fmpqb_registration_form] in any post or page.

When will the quiz feature be available?

The quiz functionality will be released in September 2025 (v2.0 update).

Can I create multiple different popups?

Yes! The plugin supports creating and managing unlimited popup variations.

Is this compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, but you may need to exclude popup pages from full-page caching.

How do I export user data?

Go to Form Registration → Users and use the “Export to CSV” button. For advanced export options, support the plugin to unlock the Supporter Edition.

Can I search and filter users?

Yes! Version 1.6 includes advanced search and filtering by user roles and fields.
